integrations.apps.unconfigured: No integration runtime is configured on this Gateway (INTEGRATION_RUNTIME_URL). The runtime is a separate container that holds the provider catalog and runs OAuth; once it is set, every provider it knows appears here.
integrations.categories.label: Integration categories
integrations.channel.whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business (Cloud API)
integrations.channel.whatsapp.setup: Needs a WhatsApp Business account, an app with an access token and a public webhook URL. Start the deskmates-whatsapp service with those values; the Gateway holds only the thread binding.
integrations.channel.whatsapp.summary: A business number through Meta's Cloud API and a webhook.
integrations.channel.whatsappWeb.name: WhatsApp (linked device)
integrations.channel.whatsappWeb.setup: Start the deskmates-whatsapp-web service next to the Gateway with the operator token, this workspace's id and the bots it may wake, open its page and scan the QR from WhatsApp › Linked devices. Messages from allowed senders arrive as chats here; replies go back to the phone.
integrations.channel.whatsappWeb.summary: Scan a QR code from a phone; no Meta business account needed.
integrations.channels.explain.disconnect: Deskmates cannot reach this account right now. Select Retry; if it keeps failing, disconnect and connect again.
integrations.channels.explain.noBot: Add a bot to this workspace first: every conversation on this channel goes to one default bot.
integrations.channels.explain.notConnect: Not connected yet. Choose how to connect and which bot answers, then select Connect.
integrations.channels.explain.reconnect: The account signed out. Select Reconnect, or disconnect and connect again with new details.
integrations.channels.explain.relink: The phone unlinked this device, or the saved link is no longer valid. Select Link again and scan the new QR code.
integrations.channels.intro: Chats that live in another app. A channel is a service beside the Gateway; the Gateway holds only the binding between a chat here and a conversation there.
integrations.channels.intro.product: Connect and manage chat channels without leaving Deskmates.
integrations.channels.label: Channels
integrations.channels.loadFailed: Could not load the channel status.
integrations.channels.scanQr: Scan this code in WhatsApp to link the account.
integrations.channels.title: Channels
integrations.channels.unavailable.body: Ask the person who runs Deskmates to update or restart it so the built-in channels can load. Nothing on this page needs to be set up first.
integrations.channels.unavailable.saved: Your saved connection is kept and resumes when its channel is available again.
integrations.channels.unavailable.title: Chat channels are not available on this server right now.
integrations.connect.description: One account for this workspace. Every bot in it may use the connection; a second account needs another name. Connecting Google Drive grants file access separately from signing in to Deskmates or another app with Google.
integrations.connect.name: Connection name
integrations.connect.oauthNotice: Finish the grant in the new tab, then refresh this list.
integrations.connect.oauthUnavailable: OAuth needs the Gateway's public callback URL to be set; an API key still works.
integrations.connect.title: Connect {name}
integrations.database.credential: Credential (sent as a bearer token by the Gateway only)
integrations.database.description: The connector-postgres service in front of your database. Bots submit batches to it through the Gateway and get a receipt; they never see the URL or the credential.
integrations.database.name: Name
integrations.database.title: Register a database
integrations.databases.addIntro: Runs as the connector-postgres service next to the Gateway; register it here with its URL and a credential. The Gateway keeps both in its secrets store.
integrations.databases.intro: Receipted connectors: every submission is validated, run once and receipted.
integrations.databases.label: Databases
integrations.databases.title: Databases
integrations.databases.usage: A bot names {name} in its connectors list to use it.
